hooks.command: bash -c 'repo_root=$(pwd -P); while [ "$repo_root" != "/" ] && [ ! -e "$repo_root/.git" ] && [ ! -f "$repo_root/.codex/hooks.json" ]; do repo_root=${repo_root%/*}; [ -n "$repo_root" ] || repo_root=/; done; if [ ! -f "$repo_root/.codex/hooks.json" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f "$repo_root/.codex/tbd-session.sh" ]; then echo "[tbd] Cannot locate the Codex session hook." >&2; exit 1; fi; exec bash "$repo_root/.codex/tbd-session.sh"'
